notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Smothering Abomination's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
